newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nearly half of Nigerians are children - minister.
newsitem.headline: Nearly half of Nigerians are children - minister.

text.p: Almost half of Nigeria's 100 million people, Africa's biggest population, are children, the government said on Tuesday.

"A little less than half, 45 percent to be precise, of Nigeria's population are children under the age of 15 years," national planning minister Ayo Ogunlade said in a report published by Nigeria and United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF).
Ogunlade said this called for massive investment in children and women.
"When one refers to the welfare of Nigerian children, one is is considering the welfare of close to 50 million people," he said.
UNICEF last year launched a fund to raise money to help execute a series of welfare schemes for children it is undertaking in the West African nation.
